HEEWON STYLE — a KOREAN WEBTOON character-introduction splash used as a movie still, the look of a dramatic manhwa cover. BOLD THICK digital-ink faces with real line weight, painted splash, visible brush, paper grain. DAY GROUND unless the scene says night: high-key paper-white sky and pale stone, the figure the dark inked thing. NOT photoreal, NOT a European oil portrait, NOT live-action, NOT 3D, NOT Caravaggio, NOT pores. Composed for a 2:1 letterbox crop; nothing important at the top or bottom edge. Face and clothes from the attached sheet; a new verb pose, never the sheet stance. No text. No watermark.
